title: About the clinic
text: CareWell Clinic is a multi-specialty outpatient clinic in Karimnagar, Telangana. It offers General Medicine, Pediatrics, Dermatology, Orthopedics and Gynecology consultations along with basic lab and pharmacy services.

title: Working hours and timings
text: The clinic is open Monday to Saturday from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Lunch break is from 1:00 PM to 2:00 PM, when no appointments are scheduled. The clinic is closed on Sundays and on public holidays.

title: Location, address and directions
text: CareWell Clinic is at 12-4-56, Main Road, Karimnagar, Telangana 505001. Free two-wheeler and car parking is available in front of the building. The clinic is wheelchair accessible with a ramp and a lift.

title: Contact details, phone and email
text: Phone: +91 98765 43210 (Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 5 PM). Email: hello@carewellclinic.example. For appointment changes please call at least 4 hours before the slot.

title: Departments and doctors
text: General Medicine: Dr. Anitha Reddy and Dr. Suresh Kumar. Pediatrics: Dr. Lakshmi Prasad. Dermatology: Dr. Ravi Teja. Orthopedics: Dr. Venkat Rao. Gynecology: Dr. Swathi Naidu. All doctors are demo profiles for this project.

title: Consultation fees and charges
text: Consultation fee is Rs. 300 for General Medicine and Pediatrics, and Rs. 500 for Dermatology, Orthopedics and Gynecology. A follow-up visit within 7 days of the first consultation is free. Lab test charges are separate.

title: How to book an appointment
text: Appointments can be booked on this website using the Book Appointment page by choosing the department, doctor, date and time slot. Walk-in patients are accepted but appointment patients are seen first. Each slot is 30 minutes.

title: How to reschedule or cancel an appointment (cancellation policy)
text: Appointments can be rescheduled or cancelled free of charge up to 4 hours before the slot by calling the clinic. No-shows are not charged, but repeated no-shows may need advance booking confirmation.

title: Documents to bring for the visit
text: Please bring a photo ID, previous prescriptions, recent lab reports and a list of current medicines. Children should bring their vaccination card. Arrive 10 minutes before your slot for registration.

title: Payment methods
text: The clinic accepts cash, UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), and debit and credit cards. Payment is collected at the reception after consultation.

title: Insurance and cashless treatment
text: Cashless facility is not available for outpatient consultations. A bill and receipt are provided so that patients can claim reimbursement from their insurance provider where their policy allows it.

title: Laboratory services
text: Basic lab services include blood tests, urine tests and blood sugar tests. Sample collection is from 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM. Most reports are ready within 24 hours. Fasting tests need 8 to 10 hours of fasting.

title: Pharmacy
text: An in-house pharmacy is open during clinic hours and dispenses only medicines prescribed by the clinic doctors.

title: Emergency care
text: CareWell Clinic is an outpatient clinic and does not provide emergency or overnight services. In an emergency, call 108 for an ambulance or go to the nearest hospital emergency department immediately.

title: Appointment confirmation and reminders
text: After booking, patients receive a confirmation message with the doctor, date and time. A reminder message is sent one day before the appointment. Patients can ask to reschedule by calling the clinic.

title: Privacy of patient information
text: Patient details are used only for scheduling and communication. This demo application uses synthetic data only and does not store real medical records.
